method: single-stream /v1/chat/completions against a local fak serve (engine=inkernel, empty --backend = CPU reference path). Decode tok/s = 1/slope of per-length MIN wall vs completion_tokens (min = least-contended); prefill tok/s = prompt_tokens/intercept (intercept absorbs fixed per-request overhead, so a floor). Streaming TTFT is unusable here: fak buffers the completion so time-to-first-token == wall.

box.note: high-RAM CPU-only Windows workstation; ~75 GiB in use by concurrent sessions at run time, so fak's capacity pre-check saw ~178 GiB free

findings: gemma4-coding-Q4_K_M and Qwen3.6-27B-Q4_K_M (262144-token windows) are REFUSED at load without --context-budget-tokens: auto-sized KV needs ~164-172 GiB and overflows the ~178 GiB fit budget (typed FitTooBig, not an OOM crash). Capping to 8192 tokens shrinks KV to a few GiB and both serve. The Qwen2.5 models (32k window) fit unaided.

config.advertised_model_id: mock — this is the default --model /v1/models LABEL only (no --model passed); the real weights are the --gguf loaded into the in-kernel engine, decoded on the CPU reference path (serve.go:146,165)
